mechanisms.name: sexual deception
mechanisms.statement: Eucera (solitary bees) is reported to pollinate the subject by sexual deception.

mechanisms.name: habitual self-pollination
mechanisms.statement: Habitual self-pollination is reported as the reproductive strategy (predominant throughout the range), which is a separate account of how seed set occurs.

mechanisms.name: no pollinator relationship in this population
mechanisms.statement: An observed insect visit does not establish pollination. Where a non-insect strategy already accounts for seed set, a visiting insect may be incidental.

contradictions.description: One report describes an insect-mediated system; the other describes reproduction that needs no insect. They are not reconciled by preferring the better-supported one.
